title: intel-build-log
universal_lens: The sovereign primitive is a constrained state-transition operator acting on a high-dimensional feature manifold. It maps raw telemetry to engineered priors via a budget-gated firing mechanism, enforcing strict orthogonality constraints to prevent collinearity while dynamically managing queue depth and computational resource allocation.
gsi_mapping: GSI utilizes these primitives as Bayesian updating kernels. The drive-failure-rate acts as a conjugate prior for turnover propensity, while game-script half-splits provide conformal prediction sets for second-half scoring distributions, strictly bounded by the empirical failure rates of preceding autonomous sessions.
gse_mapping: Within GSE, these operators dictate situational state transitions. A shadow module re-proposal enforces a hard reset on the play-calling Markov chain at halftime, recalibrating the offensive-minus-defensive snap differential based on observed first-half target-dominance composites and pressure-behavior anomalies.

primitives.name: Drive Failure Rate Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Fired: sessions/2108134241170113457 "INTEL: drive-failure-rate team feature (turnovers+punts per drive)" — IN_PROGRESS at +1min, AUTO_CREATE_PR, main.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Dimensionless ratio representing the probability of a non-scoring drive termination event (turnover or punt) normalized by total drives initiated.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes drive outcomes follow a negative binomial process where failure events are independent of down-and-distance given the current state vector.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities emerge in garbage-time scenarios where optimal strategy dictates intentional failure, decoupling the metric from true defensive efficacy.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to the GSE possession-termination kernel, serving as the primary decay factor for expected points added (EPA) during sustained drives.
layer2.telemetry: Observed turnovers plus punts divided by total drives per team per week.

layer2.telemetry: Variance in pass attempt rate between H1 and H2 conditional on point differential.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architecture inherits from classical control theory and automated theorem proving. The budget-gated firing mirrors pulse-width modulation in embedded systems, preventing integrator windup. The 'shadow module' concept traces back to ensemble methods in machine learning, specifically bagging and boosting, where weak learners are iteratively refined. The strict separation of concerns—BUILD vs. CONTENT—echoes the Model-View-Controller pattern, adapted here for quantitative research pipelines to isolate mathematical derivation from narrative generation.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models opposing agents (coaches, players) as bounded rational actors operating under strict temporal and score-constraint pressures. By extracting 'game-script half-splits', it infers the latent cognitive shift occurring at halftime, recognizing that trailing teams abandon long-term efficiency for short-term variance maximization. The 'drive-failure-rate' captures the defensive agent's ability to force suboptimal decisions from the offense, effectively modeling the psychological pressure exerted by a dominant defense. This dual-perspective allows GSE to simulate not just physical outcomes, but the strategic博弈 (game) unfolding in real-time.

This anti-collinearity check ensures that the GSI posterior distributions remain robust and that GSE state transitions are driven by independent sources of information.
